{{short description|Describes the Spanier–Whitehead dual of a secondary cohomology operation}}
In mathematics, the '''Peterson–Stein formula''', introduced by {{harvs|txt|last1=Peterson|first1=Franklin P.|author1-link=Franklin P. Peterson|last2=Stein|first2=Norman|year=1960}},  describes the [[Spanier–Whitehead dual]] of a [[secondary cohomology operation]].
